subject.title: Adopt the core durable ingress drain on the remaining channels (WhatsApp, Discord, Slack, Signal, iMessage)

question: Should this issue remain the umbrella through Wave 4 and the maintainer live-verification round, or should the completed five-channel title scope close now with the remaining fleet work tracked elsewhere?
rationale: The title’s named channels are covered by merged work, but the assigned owner explicitly broadened the issue and stated a later closure condition; only maintainer intent can safely determine the tracker boundary.

options.title: Keep the fleet-wide umbrella

options.title: Close the original title scope
